title: Other Insurance on the Contents — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
Apportionment of contents payments on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) against the named insured's BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines).

**Rule.** The other insurance on the contents is settled as follows: when that BizFlood policy declares a contents value for the address and a value endorsement for that location was in force on the date of loss, it is the contents limit set by that endorsement, the value endorsement in force being, of the value increase and the value decrease endorsed for the location, the one that took effect later among those that took effect on or before the date of loss, an increase and a decrease taking effect the same day being settled by the one recorded later, and by the increase when both were recorded the same day; when that BizFlood policy declares a contents value for the address and no value endorsement for that location was in force on the date of loss, it is the contents value on its statement of values; otherwise there is none.

That BizFlood policy is the named insured's BizFlood policy whose statement of values schedules the building's address, in force on the date of loss and not written excess of the National Flood Insurance Program.

## Records read

The BizFlood statement of values contents value for the address, and its value increase and value decrease endorsements for the address with their effective dates, recorded dates and contents limits.

## Ladder

1. Contents value declared and a value endorsement in force on the date of loss → the contents limit that endorsement sets.
2. Contents value declared, no value endorsement in force on the date of loss → the statement of values contents value.
3. Otherwise → no other insurance on the contents.

Of an increase and a decrease both in force, the later effective one counts; on the same effective day the later recorded one; on the same effective and recorded day the increase.

## Cases (hypothetical; date of loss 8 August)

- Statement of values contents value 120,000; value decrease to 90,000 effective 1 July: other insurance 90,000.
- The same decrease effective 1 September: other insurance 120,000.
